prereg.title: alpha_50 -- the steering price of refusal, powered and de-confounded
prereg.primary_estimand: alpha_50 = steering coefficient (units of NORM_L) at which a FRESH constant-alpha generation on a BENIGN prompt refuses with prob 0.5, from a logistic dose-response fit by maximum likelihood on Bernoulli draws.
prereg.H1a_reachability: max refusal rate over the grid: base < 0.5 (undefined alpha_50) vs instruct/abliterated reaching 1.0. Expected to replicate.
prereg.H1b_price: alpha_50(abliterated) > alpha_50(instruct). PAIRED bootstrap over PROMPTS of the difference. IF THE 95% CI OVERLAPS 0 -> claim (b) is WITHDRAWN in the text and the metric is reported as base-vs-tuned separation only.
prereg.H1c_lexical: alpha_50 from the PARAPHRASE-DISJOINT axis is unchanged within the CI of alpha_50 from the canned axis. If it moves outside, alpha_50 is (at least partly) LEXICAL -- reported as the finding, not a failure.
prereg.H1d_judge: alpha_50 scored by the repaired semantic judge agrees with the regex estimate within CIs; kappa(regex, judge) reported.
prereg.H1e_nonsafety_null: the norm-matched FORMAL-vs-CASUAL stylistic axis does NOT reproduce the model ordering (base undefined < instruct < abliterated).
prereg.alpha_units: alpha in units of NORM_L = median ||h_L(last prompt token)||_2 over the 20 benign probe prompts, per model; raw-activation alpha also reported (alpha_raw = alpha * NORM_L).
prereg.alpha_grid: coarse 0.00..2.00 step 0.20 (11 pts), then DENSE step 0.05 over the bracketing interval [a_lo-0.2, a_hi+0.2] found by the coarse pass; alpha_max = 2.00 is an OUTER EDGE OF MEASUREMENT (fluency screen fails above it), NOT a property of the model -- stated in the paper.
prereg.resampling_unit_for_CIs: PROMPT (within model); LINEAGE reported where n allows
prereg.sign_convention: excess width / differences are reported as (abliterated - instruct); positive = abliteration RAISES the price of refusal.
prereg.site_rule: outcome-blind: the (position-family, layer) site is the iteration-1 site of the REFERENCE model Qwen3-0.6B instruct -- response-contrast family, layer 7 of 28, relative depth 0.25, site score 0.69 vs 0.27 for the prompt-contrast axis. Transferred to every other model by RELATIVE DEPTH L = round(0.25 * n_layers). ALL FOUR AXES USE THE SAME SITE.

axes.A_canned: iteration-1 REFUSAL_RESPONSES vs COMPLY_RESPONSES response contrast
axes.B_paraphrase_disjoint: 8 refusal + 8 compliance paraphrases whose surface tokens are disjoint from the scoring lexicon; length- and syntax-matched
axes.C_stylistic: 8 FORMAL vs 8 CASUAL answers, a non-safety semantic contrast
axes.D_random: matched random Gaussian unit vector, 3 seeds

prereg.fluency_gate: distinct-3 >= 0.50 and max 5-gram repeat <= 3; failing rows are EXCLUDED from the dose-response fit and counted; if >25% of rows at an alpha fail, that alpha is censored and flagged as beyond the measurement edge.
prereg.estimators: 2-parameter logistic MLE on raw Bernoulli draws (primary when floor/ceiling are 0/1), 4-parameter logistic with free floor/ceiling, and a non-parametric linear-interpolation alpha_50 as a robustness column. Cluster bootstrap over PROMPTS (5000 resamples) for CIs.
live_possibilities: the paired CI overlaps 0 -> claim (b) WITHDRAWN (pre-registered)
the paraphrase axis moves alpha_50 outside its CI -> alpha_50 is LEXICAL
the stylistic axis reproduces the ordering -> not safety-specific

deviations.what_changed: steering applied at one decoder block's OUTPUT, not its input
deviations.why: the hook surface that actually fires on this transformers version

deviations.what_changed: alpha expressed in units of NORM_L rather than raw activation
deviations.why: raw alpha is not comparable across models with different residual scales

deviations.what_changed: steering site selected by measured steerability on held-out benign prompts
deviations.why: outcome-blind selection; the d-prime argmax layer was not steerable

deviations.what_changed: refusal entered at generation ONSET at constant alpha instead of by an up-ramp
deviations.why: the up-ramp never fires once a compliant prefix is in the KV cache (10/10 failures)

deviations.what_changed: compliance-resumption requires a marker-free window, not just a non-opener run
deviations.why: '...that request. However,' was being scored as compliance
case-insensitive 'sorry' fired on self-corrections that are not refusals

deviations.what_changed: steering axis switched from the harmful-vs-benign PROMPT contrast to a CAA-style RESPONSE contrast
deviations.why: the prompt axis reaches held-out AUROC 1.0 yet induces fluent refusals on only 27% of probes

deviations.what_changed: judge switched to meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct with an EVALUATOR_SYSTEM framing
deviations.why: the un-framed cheap judge collapsed the COMPLIANCE class to 0 on a balanced probe

deviations.what_changed: the alpha_50 dose-response is measured at temperature 0.7 with 5 seeds per prompt, where iteration 1 measured it greedily (temperature 0) on 5 prompts
deviations.why: a greedy curve has no within-prompt variance, so no confidence interval and no paired test are possible; buying power is the entire point of this artifact. The iteration-1 greedy configuration is re-run verbatim as the TIER-0 replication gate so the port can be checked against 0.475.

deviations.what_changed: probe prompts are drawn from the frozen harmless_dynamics dataset (20, stratified 2 per category over 10 categories) instead of iteration 1's 30 hard-coded benign prompts
deviations.why: the dataset block was built for exactly this purpose and its rows are vetted (meta.selected) and uid-addressable, which makes the prompt-level cluster bootstrap auditable

deviations.what_changed: paraphrase disjointness is asserted against (i) the classifier's own refusal token-id set, (ii) an explicit banned-substring list, and (iii) the frozen Qwen3 refusal_onset lexicon as a LEADING token
deviations.why: requiring that no token of a paraphrase appear anywhere in the refusal id set is unsatisfiable for ordinary English -- the id set contains 'I', 'It', 'As', 'That' -- so the constraint is applied to every token but the candidate pool is filtered automatically and the survivors are recorded

deviations.what_changed: checkpoints are loaded at their default revision and the resolved commit SHA is RECORDED, rather than passed as revision= to from_pretrained
deviations.why: models.py is reused VERBATIM from iteration 1 and its loader takes no revision argument; changing it would break the byte-identical-reuse claim. The resolved SHA is cross-checked against the frozen panel_manifest revision where one exists, so the run is auditable even though it is not load-time pinned.

deviations.what_changed: the Wilson-interval unit test compares against the closed-form Wilson value [0.1119, 0.4687] for k=5, n=20, not the [0.087, 0.491] quoted in the plan
deviations.why: [0.087, 0.491] is the Clopper-Pearson EXACT interval for those counts, not the Wilson score interval. Both are reported; Wilson remains the pre-registered interval.

deviations.what_changed: a fifth axis E (harmful-vs-benign PROMPT contrast, from the frozen layer_contrast block) and an UNSTEERED behavioural benchmark (xstest_overrefusal / plain_harmful core-80 / jailbreak_suite) were added
deviations.why: axis E is the iteration-1 AMENDMENT-7 comparator and makes the 'classification quality is not steering quality' claim measurable in this run rather than cited from the last one; the benchmark is what alpha_50 claims to replace, so it has to be run once for the substitution to be checkable at all.

deviations.what_changed: an alpha_50 that falls OUTSIDE the measured alpha range is never returned as the primary estimate; the non-parametric interpolation is used instead, and a RISING-BRANCH sensitivity (fit restricted to alphas at or below the peak of the empirical rate curve) is reported next to every estimate
deviations.why: the dose-response curve is NOT monotone for every checkpoint: past a peak, steering stops producing a refusal opener and starts producing off-task text, and a monotone logistic fitted through that tail extrapolates (e.g. a50 = 3.33 on a grid that stops at 2.0). Extrapolating past the measurement edge would report a number no data supports.
deviations.when_decided: AFTER seeing the 0.6B dose-response curves (recorded here explicitly rather than presented as pre-registered)
